facts.value: Product Design & Technology is delivered in a design studio environment, cultivating a culture of creativity, peer learning and transdisciplinary exploration.
Introduction to the methods and principles of design (sketching, prototyping, design communication) through multiple design projects, along with a discourse on the role of design in society.

Build on core design skills to further hone critical design-thinking approach, and develop skillset through digital design visualisation, CAD, user-centred design research, and in-context design projects.
Continue to develop design fluency and refinement skills while realising the potential impact their work has on community, industry and the planet.
In Semester 2, students can undertake an 8-month industry placement to equip them with real-world design experience, or study abroad at one of the global academic partner institutions.
Work with external partners through a six-week Real World Studio project, developing impactful, industry-focused solutions for a real client such as a company, community, or NGO partner.

Final-year Design Project, a self-selected design project focusing on a problem or opportunity identified by the student, delivering an effective, impactful solution through demonstration of design skills.
Design@UL, the School’s annual public Design exhibition.
